dashboard.title: Administration
dashboard.subtitle: Manage users, access and instance settings.

users.title: Users
users.emptyDescription: Invite the first person to the platform.
users.noResultsDescription: No user matches the current search and filters.

deactivateDialog.title: Deactivate this user?
deactivateDialog.description: {name} will no longer be able to sign in. Their data and progress are kept.

activateDialog.title: Reactivate this user?
activateDialog.description: {name} will be able to sign in again.

edit.title: Edit user
edit.roleHint: The role defines which areas the user can open.

invite.title: Invite user
invite.description: The invite lets the person create an account on this platform.
invite.linkReady: Invite created. Share this link with the person:
invite.copyFailed: Could not copy the link. Select it and copy manually.
invite.mockNote: In this demo no e-mail is sent, so share the link yourself.

grants.title: Course access
grants.emptyDescription: Grants show up here when instructors give students access to courses.
grants.noResultsDescription: No grant matches the current search and filters.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke access?
revokeDialog.description: {name} will immediately lose access to {course}. Their progress is kept.

extend.title: Change access expiry
extend.description: Set how long {name} keeps access. Expired access becomes active again.

brand.title: Branding
brand.name: Platform name
brand.logoUrlHint: Optional. Leave empty to use the default logo.

languages.title: Languages
languages.defaultHint: Used for new users and whenever a translation is missing.

email.title: Transactional e-mail
email.description: SMTP server used for invites, password recovery and certificates. The password is set in the SMTP_PASSWORD environment variable. The demo sends nothing.

video.title: Video
video.watermark: Show the student's name and e-mail over uploaded videos
video.watermarkHint: Discourages sharing recordings and shows who a leaked copy came from. It does not apply to videos embedded from external providers (YouTube, Vimeo and so on).
video.singleStream: Play one uploaded video at a time per account
video.singleStreamHint: When a second device starts playing, the first one pauses, which makes sharing an account with a group impractical. Instructors and admins are not limited, and videos embedded from external providers are not covered.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Extensions let you connect the platform to other tools.

videoProviders.title: Video providers
videoProviders.description: Instructors can paste links only from the providers that are on. Turning one off does not affect lessons that already use it: they keep playing. Each provider is a small plugin in the code, so adding another needs no changes elsewhere.

webhooks.name: Outbound webhooks
webhooks.description: Notify other systems when events happen, such as a new user or a completed course.

apiTokens.name: API tokens
apiTokens.description: Let trusted integrations create and manage access through the API.

examplePlugin.name: Example plugin
examplePlugin.description: A documented starting point for building your own extension.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Send a signed HTTP request to another system whenever something happens on the platform.
webhooks.emptyDescription: Add an address to be notified when people sign up, get access or finish courses.

errors.notPublic: The address is not public (it points to a private network).
errors.noAddress: The host did not resolve to any address.
errors.connectionClosed: The connection closed before the answer ended.
errors.disabled: The endpoint was disabled before delivery.

form.description: OpenCourse sends a POST request with a JSON body to this address.
form.urlHint: Plain http only works when the server allows private networks.
form.noteHint: Optional. Helps you remember what it is for.

secret.title: Signing secret
secret.description: Use it to check that a request really comes from this platform. It is shown only now: copy it before closing.
secret.label: Secret
secret.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
secret.howTo: Every request carries an OpenCourse-Signature header with a timestamp (t) and an HMAC-SHA256 signature (v1) of the timestamp and the body, made with this secret.

rotateDialog.title: Create a new secret?
rotateDialog.description: The current secret stops working immediately. Update the receiver with the new one.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this webhook?
deleteDialog.description: {url} stops receiving events and its delivery history is deleted.

deliveries.title: Delivery history
deliveries.description: Requests from the last 7 days, newest first.
deliveries.emptyDescription: Deliveries show up here after an event happens.

videos.title: Failed videos
videos.description: Uploaded videos the encoder gave up on. Send one back once the cause is fixed; if the original file is gone, the instructor has to upload it again.
videos.emptyDescription: Every uploaded video was processed. Failures show up here.
videos.limitNotice: Showing the latest {count} failures. Older ones appear here once these are dealt with.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Let server-side plugins create and manage access through the API. A key acts as the admin who created it and works only on the grant routes.
apiKeys.emptyDescription: Create a key for a plugin that grants access, for example one that sells courses elsewhere.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke this API key?
revokeDialog.description: {name} stops working immediately and cannot be restored. Plugins that use it lose access.

form.title: Create API key
form.description: Give it a name that tells you which plugin uses it.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: For example, the store that sells your courses.

token.title: API key token
token.description: Copy it now. It is shown only this once and cannot be retrieved later.
token.warning: Anyone with this token can create and revoke access to your courses. Store it somewhere safe and never share it.
token.label: Token
token.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
token.howTo: The plugin sends it as Authorization: Bearer <token>, together with the X-Requested-With: opencourse header, to the grant routes.
